column1: # Clip names already published on Hugging Face, keyed by the span they
# cover. A per-sentence clip is sliced out of the whole-story recording
# named by AUDIO/@url, so the span -- not the sentence id -- is what
# identifies it. Recording the mapping here pins those names for good:
# a rebuild that renumbers sentences keeps every clip whose audio is
# unchanged, and only genuinely new spans need slicing.
# occurrence disambiguates the 15 spans that appear twice within one
# story; it counts from 0 in document order.
# Provenance: the AUDIO elements of the corpus as published on main,
# which is what the Hugging Face dataset was sliced from.
